verdicts.reason: Both have the same broken composition. The GLACIER wordmark floats alone at top centre-right, above an empty quadrant. The headline and body are indented to x≈255, while the badges and the CTA sit on different, arbitrary left edges, so nothing shares an axis and the left side below the circle is dead space. In A the body copy is jammed against the badge row. B's vertical gaps are slightly more even, so B is marginally better.
